title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording indicator for call queue calls on Mobile
description: For call queue calls that are automatically recorded by the organization, Teams on Mobile will clearly indicate that recording and transcription have started automatically and cannot be stopped. This gives users clearer and more accurate information about the recording state of their call and provides a consistent experience across desktop and mobile.
